reason: README's transcription step (audios_to_midis.py transcribe_piano) runs on CPU on a short audio clip with an automatically downloaded checkpoint.
demo: README 'Transcribe audios to MIDI files': python3 audios_to_midis.py transcribe_piano
goal: Install the dependencies (PyTorch CPU, requirements.txt, piano_transcription_inference, librosa, ffmpeg) and make `python3 audios_to_midis.py transcribe_piano --workspace=... --mp3s_dir=<dir with an mp3 named after the first catalogue entry in resources/full_music_pieces_youtube_similarity_pianosoloprob_split.csv> --midis_dir=<out> --begin_index=0 --end_index=1` run on CPU and write a .mid file. YouTube downloading is not required; the mp3 is supplied. The transcription checkpoint is downloaded automatically by the library.
check: A short synthetic mp3 named after catalogue entry 0 is transcribed on CPU and the resulting .mid file is a valid MIDI file containing notes.
